claims: C1 a user is a person who uses a product made by OpenAI or a third-party application built on the OpenAI API
C2 users typically see only the conversation messages designated for their view
C3 users may not be aware of developer or system messages
C4 users' goals may not align with the developer's goals
C5 in API applications, the assistant cannot know whether an end user distinct from the developer exists, nor how the assistant's messages relate to what the end user does or sees

concepts.name: user_definition
concepts.gloss: U is a user of a product made by OpenAI or of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API

concepts.name: openai_product
concepts.gloss: P is a product made by OpenAI, such as ChatGPT

concepts.name: openai_api_application
concepts.gloss: A is a third-party application built on the OpenAI API, such as a customer service chatbot for an e-commerce site

concepts.name: uses
concepts.gloss: U uses P, where P is a product or application
concepts.inference: the definition of user is given in terms of using a product or application, so a uses relation is needed

concepts.name: sees_only_designated_messages
concepts.gloss: U typically sees only the conversation messages that have been designated for their view

concepts.name: may_not_be_aware_of_developer_or_system_messages
concepts.gloss: U may not be aware of any developer or system messages

concepts.name: goals_may_not_align_with_developer
concepts.gloss: U's goals may not align with the developer's goals

concepts.name: api_application
concepts.gloss: A is an application built on the OpenAI API

concepts.name: assistant_cannot_know_end_user_relation
concepts.gloss: in API application A, the assistant has no way of knowing whether an end user distinct from the developer exists, nor how the assistant's input and output messages relate to what the end user does or sees

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
